citations.claim: at step 1 controller_force 83.438 exceeds fmax 64.183, body has moved left toward waypoint
speed reflects uncontrolled acceleration from excessive force
initial state at rest before violation

counterfactual.change: set controller noise from 0.228 to 0 (single field) – removes post-clamp noise scaling, force stays within fmax

explanation: Controller force limit bypassed by seeded sensor noise applied after clamping. With kp*vcmd >> fmax the base command saturates at fmax (64.18), but noise factor ~1.30 scales it to 83.44 exceeding fmax. Raising fmax preserves ratio (117/90=1.30, 260/200=1.30) showing noise multiplies after the limit. Setting noise to 0 removes scaling and keeps force within limit.
vision_note: Panels 0 and 1 show a single red body on the right holding position near a green waypoint on the left, with no walls or other bodies visible. There is essentially no displacement between the two steps and no visible collision, penetration or large acceleration.
